shortDescription: Advanced Dev Tools (formerly Modern Dev Tools): a QoL overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools — three-column debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them, knowledge base, dev actions + palette, log throttling, mod-change detection, public v2 API. Now skinnable: vanilla RimWorld look by default, Modern-suite skin opt-in.
body:
## Advanced Dev Tools (formerly Modern Dev Tools)

A QoL overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools. **Renamed from "Modern Dev Tools" to "Advanced Dev Tools" (player-facing only)** — internals unchanged for compat: packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`, namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, API class `ModernDevToolsAPI` (frozen v2), ModSettings class, GitHub URLs, `MDT_` key names. C# + Harmony. MIT. **Version constant still `1.3`** — bump to 1.4 at release time (update-notes body still describes 1.3 and needs a rewrite then; About.xml description + Steam page + Preview.png also still carry Modern branding, deferred by user decision).

### Rebrand mechanics (done 2026-08; build green)
- About.xml `<name>` → Advanced Dev Tools (description untouched — user-owned).
- `ModernDevToolsMod.LogPrefix` → `"[Advanced Dev Tools]"` AND all ~100 hardcoded `[Modern Dev Tools]` literals swept in the same pass — **critical: `Module_StackTrace` self-report suppression compares message prefix against LogPrefix; a partial rename would resurrect the run-#232 self-blame bug.** Test-fixture prefix `[Advanced Dev Tools test] ` is still NOT a prefix-match of LogPrefix (trailing "]" vs " t"), so fixtures still attribute to us by design.
- `SettingsCategory()` → "Advanced Dev Tools"; debug-actions category → "Advanced Dev Tools" (old palette pins to the "Modern Dev Tools\…" category paths die — cosmetic).
- Keyed values renamed; "modern log" phrasing scrubbed from MDT_YieldLogWindowDesc; `<MDT_UpdateNotesTitle>` renamed. Keyed count 355 (+3 appearance keys).

## DUAL SKIN — vanilla default, Modern opt-in (NEW, replaces "the mod wears the suite skin")
Setting `modernSkin` (default **false** = vanilla). Existing 1.3 subscribers flip to vanilla on update by design ("this is a QoL mod, not a UI mod").

### Architecture (house dual-skin rule enforced)
- **Every skin branch lives in the style layer** — `Palette` + `Spatial` (+ the log window's three local button primitives + `Palette.Micro`). **Zero call-site branches**; a control built from the helpers supports both skins by construction.
- Palette tokens are now **mutable static fields** swapped wholesale by `Palette.ApplySkin(bool)`. Nothing caches a palette colour into a static or bakes one into a texture (Spatial tints white art at draw time) → live toggle is safe.
- **Deferred apply:** settings toggle calls `Palette.RequestSkin`; `Palette.SyncSkin()` runs in the permanent `Root.Update` postfix (alongside SyncIfNeeded/DrainSummaries/TickPending), so the palette never mutates between OnGUI passes of one frame. Settings page redraws in the new skin next frame = live preview.
- **Control parity across skins**: every interactive helper emits exactly one invisible button in both skins (ButtonText active ⇒ 1 control, inactive ⇒ 0 — same as the modern paths), so even a mid-frame flip couldn't shift control ids.
- `ApplySkin` runs in the Mod ctor (pure colour math; deliberately does NOT reference `Verse.Widgets` statics, whose cctor loads textures — vanilla hexes are hardcoded, verified against decompiled 1.6: window fill #15191D(21,25,29), section fill #2A2B2C, section border #878787, separator 0.3 gray).

### Vanilla skin mapping
- Panels: `Spatial.Capsule/Surface` → square fill + #878787 border when opaque (menu-section language; translucent tints stay borderless). `RowPlate/Pill` → plain square fill. `Dot` → square chip. `Elevate`/`TopHighlight` → no-ops. `Switch` + `Palette.DrawToggle`/`DrawCheck` → vanilla `Widgets.CheckboxDraw` art.
- Buttons: `GrayButton` + log-window `PlainButton/FilledButton/PillButton` → vanilla `Widgets.ButtonText` (tint distinctions dropped; vanilla buttons uniform). `CloseX` → `TexButton.CloseXSmall` ButtonImage.
- Backdrops via three new Palette helpers (all 9 windows routed): `WindowBG` (log window; modern = rounded PageBG surface, vanilla = `Widgets.DrawWindowBackground`), `DialogBG` (7 floating dialogs; modern = BG+BGL plate as shipped, vanilla = DrawWindowBackground), `PageSurface` (settings page; vanilla = `Widgets.DrawMenuSection`).
- `DrawCard` → vanilla `Widgets.DrawMenuSection`. `SectionHeader` → ListSeparator colours (0.8 label / 0.3 line). Scrollbars: `BeginScroll` pushes a null sentinel and leaves GUI.skin untouched (flat scrollbar is Modern-only); PopSkin handles null.
- `Palette.Micro(label)`: uppercase micro-headers are Modern grammar — vanilla returns sentence case. Log window + LogWidgets tray label route through it.
- Colours: PageBG/BG=#15191D, Sidebar/Panel=#2A2B2C, Group/RowAlt=lerped lighter, BGL=#878787, Stat 0.92 white, TextDim 0.66, Sep=0.3 gray, Warn→vanilla log yellow (0.95,0.85,0.25), Bad→vanilla log red (1,0.36,0.32), Good unchanged.
- **Accent in vanilla = fixed link blue; the ModernNotifications Theme.Accent reflection only runs in the Modern skin** (suite coupling dropped from the default experience).
- `HardeningPatches.ButtonText_TrayStylePrefix` bails when `!Palette.ModernSkin` — required, not just cosmetic: GrayButton delegates to ButtonText in vanilla skin, so the prefix would recurse.
- ModuleRow accent state-strip is Modern-only (checkbox carries the state in vanilla).

### Modern skin = the shipped 1.3 B1 suite look, unchanged
All B1 details from 1.3 hold verbatim when `modernSkin` is on (hex parity contract, Spatial 9-slice cost rules, frame-latch discipline, SearchFieldFlat, timestamps column, throttle chips, ADD-ONS tray, ghost-shadow fix `drawShadow=false` on the palette, etc.). `ApplyModern()` must keep the suite hexes in sync with the field initializers.

### Settings surfaces
New **Appearance card first** on `SettingsPage` (`MDT_SectionAppearance`/`MDT_ModernSkin`/`MDT_ModernSkinDesc`). Not mirrored in Dialog_Modules (quick subset). Parity contract otherwise unchanged.

### NOT yet verified in-game (next test run)
Vanilla skin on every surface (log window incl. search well/focus ring/selected-row square ring/badges-as-chips, KB, dev actions, palette, settings, report/mod-changes/update-notes dialogs); live toggle both directions; HugsLib tray in vanilla (prefix stand-down); Modern skin regression pass (should be pixel-identical to 1.3).

---

## Everything below unchanged from 1.3 (see prior sections)

### Governing rule: everything shown is a factual claim
Fail closed; match strings must be provably reachable from `Log`; never re-derive a held identity; never self-blame for reported errors; never search/sort by an undisplayed string; never show raw internal identifiers.

### Tool 1: log window (`Window_ModernLog`) — three-column layout (sidebar 212px / list / inspector), timestamps (`LogTimestamps`, first-seen on repeats), `LogThrottle` (default OFF, verified run #444), HugsLib `LogWidgets` tray + `ArchotechBridge`, `yieldLogWindow` stand-down. Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow` gated on `LogWindowCompat.ModernOwnsLog`.

### Attribution pipeline — 13 modules in `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`; `Module_StackTrace` (self-skip on LogPrefix, NamespaceRoot fallback, FrameworkRoots), `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions` (greedy grammars), `Module_HarmonyPatches`, DependencyCheck/AboutIncompat/VersionMismatch/KnownIssues/ModIssues/CommunityBugs/Community/Glossary/CircinusCorpus/ReflectionBridge. Diagnosis score scale + `IssueScoring` single matcher + ignore keys via `IgnoredLabel` — all as before.

### Correctness audit 2026-11 results stand: `ModFingerprint`/`ModChange` v2 rewrite (FNV-1a over sorted path+length, UNKNOWN never guesses, `mdtModSnapshotV2`), self-attribution fix, third-party knowledge scoping, ACTIVE-preferred index, greedy regexes, phantom-string purge, coverage adds (KnownIssueDefs 42, BenignLogDefs 5, community-bugs.json.gz 17). Known-remaining gaps unchanged (Lunar side-loading blindspot, `_steam` suffix, Turkish locale, same-name coin flip, uncovered grammars).

### Tools 2/3/4: dev actions (3-tab, node graph, icon-grid spawn pickers, BFS search, display-label fix), palette (nodes cached on hash, `drawShadow` stays false), knowledge base (8 categories, culled). All pre-B1 modern chrome but fully dual-skin via the layer now.

### Hardening: `WindowWatchdog`+`UiHardening` off by default, patches installed only while on, one permanent `Root.Update` postfix (now also `Palette.SyncSkin`). Community data opt-in w/ offline snapshot. Public API v2 frozen — no signatures changed.

### Performance: `TextMetrics` memoisation, `FirstLine` weak table, viewport culling in log/KB. Dev-actions culling + `DebugTree.Children()` latching still open.

## Docs (workspace/_dev/ModernDevTools/) — ALL still say "Modern Dev Tools"; rewrite at release: FIELD_MANUAL.md, STEAM_DESCRIPTION.txt (user-owned), community-db push still pending. `_dev/` mockups restored; B2/B5 future candidates.

## GitHub: repo + KnownIssues DB public, unchanged names (intentional — internals stable).

## Post-1.4-prep backlog
- Release pass: Version bump → 1.4, new MDT_UpdateNotesBody (rename + skin), About description rewrite, new Preview.png, FIELD_MANUAL update, Steam page copy.
- In-game verification of both skins (list above) + prior backlog (TextMetrics.Fit on big log, fingerprint cost on ~910 mods, v2 snapshot round-trip, 125/150% UI scale corners, tray with real HugsLib, Turkish matcher).
- Skin-bridge polish from screenshots: vanilla-mode fine-tuning where square translations look rough (search focus ring, selected-row ring, badge chips).
